# @robodog/server

Backend for the RoboDog search-and-rescue robot: REST + WebSocket API, SQLite storage, media store
and a clearly labelled simulation mode. The Android phone is the primary data collector (it works
offline and syncs later through `POST /api/sync`); the web "RoboDog Command Center" reads
everything from this server over REST and `/ws`.

**Accuracy rule:** the server never fabricates data. Everything generated by simulation mode carries
`source: 'SIMULATION'` (and alert messages start with `[SIMULATION] `). Unknown values are `null`,
never a made-up default. Real and simulated data are stored side by side but always distinguishable
by `source`.

## Running

```bash
# from the monorepo root (installs workspace deps, builds nothing)
npm install -w server

# development (tsx watch, real data only)
npm run dev -w server

# development with the simulator (synthetic sensors, robot status, alerts, live thermal frames)
ROBODOG_SIMULATION=true npm run dev -w server

# production
npm run build -w server && npm run start -w server

# checks
npm run typecheck -w server
npm test -w server           # vitest: hermetic (in-memory SQLite + temp media dir)
```

Stack: Node 22, TypeScript (strict, ESM), Fastify 5, `@fastify/websocket`, `@fastify/multipart`,
`@fastify/static`, `@fastify/cors`, `better-sqlite3` (WAL), zod schemas from `@robodog/shared`,
`jpeg-js` for simulated frames, vitest.

## Configuration (environment variables)

See `.env.example`. Relative paths resolve against the working directory.

| Variable | Default | Meaning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ROBODOG_PORT` | `8080` | TCP port |
| `ROBODOG_HOST` | `0.0.0.0` | Bind address |
| `ROBODOG_API_TOKEN` | `robodog-dev-token` (`DEV_API_TOKEN`) | Shared token. A warning is logged at startup when the default is used. |
| `ROBODOG_DB_PATH` | `./data/robodog.db` | SQLite file (WAL). `:memory:` for tests. |
| `ROBODOG_MEDIA_DIR` | `./media` | Root for uploaded files, served under `/media/` |
| `ROBODOG_SIMULATION` | `false` | `true` / `1` enables the simulator |
| `ROBODOG_CORS_ORIGIN` | `*` | Allowed origin(s), comma separated |
| `ROBODOG_LOG_LEVEL` | `info` | pino level |

`server/data/` and `server/media/` are git-ignored.

## Authentication

Every `/api/*` route except `GET /api/health`, every `/media/*` file and the `/ws` upgrade require
the token, presented as one of:

- header `x-robodog-token: <token>` (`AUTH_HEADER` in `@robodog/shared`)
- header `Authorization: Bearer <token>`
- query parameter `?token=<token>` (for WebSocket clients and `<img src>`)

Failures return `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`.

## Storage layout

- **SQLite** (`ROBODOG_DB_PATH`): tables `missions`, `sensor_readings`, `alerts`, `thermal_images`,
  `rgb_images`, `videos`, `thermal_maps` (metadata, bounds and point count only), `imu_samples`,
  `robot_status` (append-only history; the newest row is the current status), `robot_events`,
  `sync_log`, `devices`, `schema_migrations`. Migrations live in `src/db/migrations.ts` as versioned
  SQL strings and run automatically at startup.
- Records use client-generated text primary keys; inserting an existing id is a no-op reported as
  `duplicate`, which makes every upload and the sync queue idempotent.
- Positions are stored as `x, y, z, position_frame, position_confidence` columns. JSON metadata
  (`alerts.metadata`, `robot_status.gps`, `robot_status.extra`, `thermal_maps.bounds`) is TEXT.
- Timestamps are normalised to UTC ISO-8601 with milliseconds when stored and when used in
  `since` / `from` / `to` filters, so string comparison in SQL orders correctly.
- Mission `stats` are never stored; they are computed with SQL counts every time a mission is read.
- **Media** (`ROBODOG_MEDIA_DIR`), mirroring the phone's `STORAGE_LAYOUT`:
  - `RoboDog/Thermal/Images/<fileName>` and `RoboDog/RGB/Images/<fileName>`
  - `RoboDog/Thermal/Videos/<fileName>` and `RoboDog/RGB/Videos/<fileName>`
  - `maps/<mapId>.json` — thermal map `points` + `trajectory`
  - `tmp/` — in-flight multipart uploads
  File names are sanitised to a safe basename (path traversal is impossible). After a multipart
  upload the record's `filePath` becomes the server-relative path, e.g.
  `/media/RoboDog/Thermal/Images/thermal_20260929_143000.jpg`, and `uploaded` is `true`.

## REST API

All bodies and responses are JSON. Bodies are validated with the shared zod schemas; on failure the
server answers `400 {"error":"validation_failed","issues":[...zod issues]}`. Unknown ids answer
`404 {"error":"not_found"}`. Multipart uploads are limited to 50 MB.

| Method | Path | Body / query | Response |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/health` | – (no auth) | `HealthResponse` |
| GET | `/api/sensors` | `?limit&missionId&since` | `{ latest: SensorReading\|null, readings: SensorReading[] }` |
| POST | `/api/sensors` | `SensorReading` or `SensorReading[]` | `{ accepted: string[], duplicates: string[] }` (201 if anything was new) |
| GET | `/api/alerts` | `?missionId&type&severity&limit&acknowledged` | `Alert[]` |
| POST | `/api/alerts` | `Alert` or `Alert[]` | `{ accepted, duplicates }` |
| POST | `/api/alerts/:id/acknowledge` | – | `Alert` |
| GET | `/api/missions` | `?status&source&limit` | `Mission[]` (newest first, with stats) |
| POST | `/api/missions` | `createMissionSchema` | `Mission` (201). Server assigns `number`; `id` defaults to `mission_<uuid>`. Creating an ACTIVE mission completes the previous ACTIVE mission of the same `source`. |
| GET | `/api/missions/:id` | – | `Mission` with stats |
| PATCH | `/api/missions/:id` | `updateMissionSchema` | `Mission` |
| GET | `/api/missions/:id/summary` | – | `{ mission, alerts, thermalImages, rgbImages, videos, maps, sensorCount }` |
| GET | `/api/thermal/images` | `?missionId&from&to&limit` | `ThermalImage[]` |
| GET | `/api/thermal/images/:id` | – | `ThermalImage` |
| POST | `/api/thermal/images` | JSON `thermalImageSchema` **or** multipart `metadata` (JSON string) + `file` (JPEG) | `{ result: 'accepted'\|'duplicate', item }` |
| POST | `/api/thermal/images/:id/file` | multipart `file` | `{ result, item }` (attaches the binary to previously synced metadata) |
| DELETE | `/api/thermal/images/:id` | – | `{ deleted, id, fileRemoved }` (row + file) |
| GET/POST/DELETE | `/api/rgb/images[...]` | same pattern, `rgbImageSchema`, files under `RoboDog/RGB/Images` | |
| GET/POST/DELETE | `/api/thermal/videos[...]` | same pattern, `videoRecordingSchema` with `kind: 'THERMAL'`, files under `RoboDog/Thermal/Videos` | |
| GET/POST/DELETE | `/api/rgb/videos[...]` | same pattern, `kind: 'RGB'`, files under `RoboDog/RGB/Videos` | |
| GET | `/api/maps` | `?missionId&limit` | `ThermalMap[]` (metadata only) |
| GET | `/api/maps/:id` | – | `ThermalMap & { points, trajectory }` read from `media/maps/<id>.json` |
| POST | `/api/maps` | `thermalMapUploadSchema` | `{ result, item: ThermalMap }` |
| DELETE | `/api/maps/:id` | – | `{ deleted, id }` |
| GET | `/api/robot` | – | latest `RobotStatus & { reported: true, lastPhoneSeen }`, or when nothing was ever reported an object with every unavailable field `null` and `reported: false`. `phoneConnected` always comes from WebSocket presence. |
| POST | `/api/robot` | `RobotStatus` | `{ accepted: true, status }` (201) |
| GET | `/api/robot/events` | `?limit` | `RobotEvent[]` (phone connect/disconnect, forwarded commands) |
| GET | `/api/robot/history` | `?limit` | `RobotStatus[]` |
| POST | `/api/imu` | `{ samples: ImuSample[] }` (max 5000) | `{ count }` |
| POST | `/api/sync` | `SyncBatchRequest` | `SyncBatchResponse { accepted, duplicates, rejected }` |
| GET | `/api/storage` | `?type&missionId&from&to&limit` | `[{ mediaType, item }]` newest first, for the STORAGE page |
| GET | `/api/stats` | – | dashboard counters |
| GET | `/media/*` | `?token=` accepted | uploaded files |

### Sync semantics

Each `SyncEnvelope` is dispatched by `kind` (`sensor`, `alert`, `thermal_image`, `rgb_image`,
`video`, `map`, `mission`, `robot`, `imu_batch`) to the same insert path as the individual
endpoints. Envelope ids are recorded in `sync_log`; a resent batch reports them as `duplicates`.
Record ids are deduplicated as well, so a record that already arrived through its own endpoint is
also a duplicate. A `mission` envelope for an id that already exists updates the mutable fields
(`name`, `status`, `endTime`, `notes`) and is reported as `duplicate` (the phone can drop it).
Invalid payloads are listed in `rejected` with the zod reason; the rest of the batch still succeeds.

## WebSocket `/ws`

Implements `shared/src/ws.ts` exactly.

- Connect with `ws://host:8080/ws?token=<token>` (or send the header).
- Text frames are JSON `WsMessage`s. The first message must be
  `{ "type": "hello", "role": "phone" | "web" | "robot", "deviceId": "...", "version": "..." }`;
  the server replies `{ "type": "welcome", "serverTime", "simulation", "clientId" }`.
- `{ "type": "ping", "t": 123 }` → `{ "type": "pong", "t": 123 }`.
- **Phone → server**: `sensor`, `alert`, `robot`, `mission` messages are persisted through the same
  deduplicating path as REST and rebroadcast to web clients. Binary frames use `encodeLiveFrame`
  (`uint32 BE header length` + JSON `LiveFrameHeader` + JPEG). The newest frame per channel is
  cached, so a web client that subscribes later immediately receives the last frame.
- **Web → server**: `subscribe` / `unsubscribe` with `channels: ['thermal' | 'rgb']`, and
  `command` (`capture_thermal`, `capture_rgb`, `start_recording`, `stop_recording`) which is
  forwarded to every connected phone (an `error` is returned when no phone is connected).
- **Server → web**: `sensor`, `alert`, `robot`, `mission`, `media` (`THERMAL_IMAGE`, `RGB_IMAGE`,
  `VIDEO`, `THERMAL_MAP`), binary live frames for subscribed channels, and
  `presence { phoneConnected, webClients, lastPhoneSeen }` whenever a phone connects or disconnects
  (and once right after a web client's `welcome`).
- Heartbeat: the server pings every 10 s and terminates sockets that have been silent for 30 s.
- Phone presence feeds `GET /api/robot` (`phoneConnected`) and `GET /api/stats`.

## Simulation mode

`ROBODOG_SIMULATION=true` starts `src/simulation/simulator.ts`. It never runs when the flag is off.

- A mission named `SIMULATION MISSION` (`source: SIMULATION`) is created at startup unless a
  simulated mission is already active. Real missions are not touched.
- Every 1 s: a `SensorReading` (`id: sim_sensor_<uuid>`, temperature 20–35 °C, humidity 40–70 %,
  gas_raw 1500–2200, occasional gas alert) with a low-confidence (`0.2`) `IMU_DEAD_RECKONING`
  position on a slow circle.
- Every 5 s: a `RobotStatus` with slowly draining battery; hardware links are reported as
  disconnected because there is no hardware.
- Occasional `GAS_ALERT` / `THERMAL_INTENSITY_HOTSPOT` alerts, messages prefixed `[SIMULATION] `.
- A live thermal frame at 4 fps on channel `thermal`: a 256×192 synthetic gradient blob rendered
  through an IRON-like palette and encoded with `jpeg-js`. The header says
  `source: 'SIMULATION'`, `radiometric: false` and all temperatures `null`.
- `GET /api/health` reports `simulation: true` and the `welcome` message carries `simulation: true`.

## curl examples

```bash
TOKEN=robodog-dev-token
H="x-robodog-token: $TOKEN"
BASE=http://localhost:8080

# health (no token)
curl $BASE/api/health

# sensors
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/sensors -d '{
  "id":"sensor_1","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:00.000Z","missionId":null,"source":"REAL",
  "temperatureC":24.5,"humidityPct":55,"gasRaw":1800,"gasAlert":false,"position":null}'
curl -H "$H" "$BASE/api/sensors?limit=20"

# alerts
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/alerts -d '{
  "id":"alert_1","type":"GAS_ALERT","severity":"CRITICAL","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:01.000Z",
  "message":"Gas alert","metadata":{"gasRaw":2600},"missionId":null,"position":null,"source":"REAL"}'
curl -H "$H" "$BASE/api/alerts?acknowledged=false"
curl -H "$H" -X POST $BASE/api/alerts/alert_1/acknowledge

# missions
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/missions -d '{"name":"Warehouse sweep"}'
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/missions
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/missions/<id>
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X PATCH $BASE/api/missions/<id> -d '{"status":"COMPLETED"}'
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/missions/<id>/summary

# thermal image: metadata only (JSON)
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/thermal/images -d '{
  "id":"thermal_1","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:02.000Z","missionId":null,"cameraModel":"Fluke iSee TC01A",
  "width":256,"height":192,"fileName":"thermal_1.jpg","filePath":"content://phone/thermal_1.jpg","palette":"IRON",
  "frameFormat":"YUY2","radiometric":false,"centerTemperature":null,"minTemperature":null,"maxTemperature":null,
  "emissivity":null,"distance":null,"x":null,"y":null,"z":null,"positionFrame":null,"source":"REAL"}'

# thermal image: multipart metadata + file in one request
curl -H "$H" -X POST $BASE/api/thermal/images \
  -F 'metadata={"id":"thermal_2","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:03.000Z","missionId":null,"cameraModel":"Fluke iSee TC01A","width":256,"height":192,"fileName":"thermal_2.jpg","filePath":"","palette":"IRON","frameFormat":"YUY2","radiometric":false,"centerTemperature":null,"minTemperature":null,"maxTemperature":null,"emissivity":null,"distance":null,"x":null,"y":null,"z":null,"positionFrame":null,"source":"REAL"}' \
  -F 'file=@thermal_2.jpg;type=image/jpeg'

# attach the binary later, then fetch it
curl -H "$H" -X POST $BASE/api/thermal/images/thermal_1/file -F 'file=@thermal_1.jpg;type=image/jpeg'
curl -H "$H" "$BASE/api/thermal/images?limit=10"
curl -o out.jpg "$BASE/media/RoboDog/Thermal/Images/thermal_1.jpg?token=$TOKEN"
curl -H "$H" -X DELETE $BASE/api/thermal/images/thermal_1

# RGB image (same shapes; rgbImageSchema)
curl -H "$H" -X POST $BASE/api/rgb/images \
  -F 'metadata={"id":"rgb_1","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:04.000Z","missionId":null,"cameraId":"0","width":1920,"height":1080,"fileName":"rgb_1.jpg","filePath":"","associatedThermalImageId":"thermal_2","x":null,"y":null,"z":null,"positionFrame":null,"source":"REAL"}' \
  -F 'file=@rgb_1.jpg;type=image/jpeg'

# videos (metadata, then file)
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/thermal/videos -d '{
  "id":"video_1","kind":"THERMAL","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:05.000Z","endTimestamp":null,"missionId":null,
  "cameraModel":"Fluke iSee TC01A","width":256,"height":192,"fileName":"video_1.mp4","filePath":"",
  "durationMs":12000,"frameCount":300,"codec":"h264","palette":"IRON","source":"REAL"}'
curl -H "$H" -X POST $BASE/api/thermal/videos/video_1/file -F 'file=@video_1.mp4;type=video/mp4'
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/rgb/videos

# thermal map (points are written to media/maps/map_1.json)
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/maps -d '{
  "id":"map_1","missionId":null,"timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:06.000Z","name":"Hall A","dimension":"2D",
  "poseSource":"IMU_DEAD_RECKONING","hasDepth":false,"hasTemperature":false,"pointCount":1,"filePath":null,
  "bounds":{"minX":0,"maxX":1,"minY":0,"maxY":1,"minZ":null,"maxZ":null},"source":"REAL",
  "points":[{"x":0.5,"y":0.5,"z":null,"thermalIntensity":0.8,"temperature":null,"timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:06.000Z","frameId":"f1"}],
  "trajectory":[{"x":0,"y":0,"z":null,"timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:06.000Z"}]}'
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/maps/map_1
curl -H "$H" -X DELETE $BASE/api/maps/map_1

# robot status + events, IMU
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/robot
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/robot -d '{
  "timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:07.000Z","source":"REAL","phoneConnected":true,"esp32Connected":true,
  "thermalCameraConnected":true,"robotConnected":false,"batteryPct":87,"motorState":null,"legState":null,
  "imuAvailable":true,"moving":false,"slamStatus":null,"gps":null,"lidarAvailable":false,"activeMissionId":null,"extra":{}}'
curl -H "$H" "$BASE/api/robot/events?limit=20"
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/imu -d '{"samples":[
  {"timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:08.000Z","monotonicNs":123456789,"missionId":null,
   "ax":0,"ay":0,"az":9.81,"gx":0,"gy":0,"gz":0,"mx":null,"my":null,"mz":null}]}'

# sync batch (idempotent by envelope id and record id)
curl -H "$H" -H 'content-type: application/json' -X POST $BASE/api/sync -d '{
  "deviceId":"phone-1","items":[
    {"id":"sensor_9","kind":"sensor","createdAt":"2026-09-29T10:00:09.000Z","attempts":0,
     "payload":{"id":"sensor_9","timestamp":"2026-09-29T10:00:09.000Z","missionId":null,"source":"REAL",
                "temperatureC":22,"humidityPct":50,"gasRaw":1700,"gasAlert":false,"position":null}}]}'

# storage page + dashboard counters
curl -H "$H" "$BASE/api/storage?type=THERMAL_IMAGE&limit=50"
curl -H "$H" $BASE/api/stats

# websocket (with websocat)
websocat "ws://localhost:8080/ws?token=$TOKEN"
# then type: {"type":"hello","role":"web","deviceId":"cli"}
#            {"type":"subscribe","channels":["thermal"]}
```

## Project layout

```
server/
  src/
    main.ts                 entry point, graceful shutdown
    app.ts                  buildApp(config): plugins, routes, error handling
    config.ts               env -> Config
    auth.ts                 token auth hook (header / bearer / ?token=)
    esp32.ts                esp32PayloadToReading(), alertFromReading()
    errors.ts               ValidationError / NotFoundError / BadRequestError
    db/database.ts          better-sqlite3 (WAL) + migrations
    db/migrations.ts        versioned SQL
    db/repositories/        typed repositories returning shared types
    media/store.ts          media directory layout, sanitised file names, map JSON files
    media/upload.ts         multipart streaming to temp files
    routes/                 REST endpoints (health, sensors, alerts, missions, media, maps, robot, sync, storage, stats)
    services/ingest.ts      single persist + broadcast path used by REST, WS, sync and the simulator
    ws/hub.ts               WebSocket protocol implementation
    simulation/             simulator + synthetic JPEG renderer
    test/                   hermetic test helpers and fixtures
```
